observed_vs_expected: Expected score to increase as lambda_ref approached 550 nm; instead, it dropped significantly from 0.8497 to 0.6163 (direction: lower, magnitude: ~0.233), satisfying the alternative expectation that the score would plateau below 0.7 if the hypothesis failed. tightest_margin remained positive at 0.9090, consistent with the expectation that margins stay positive when geometry is achievable. valid_candidates held stable at 9, matching the expectation of stable candidate counts across rounds.
deviation_mechanism: The 20-layer quarter-wave stack lacks sufficient independent phase-control degrees of freedom to sustain high optical contrast across both target bands when lambda_ref departs from 550 nm. Shifting the reference wavelength alters the intended Bragg condition, pushing the designed stopband/passband mismatch beyond what 20 layers of fixed material dispersion can compensate. The persistently positive tightest_margin (0.9090) confirms hard geometric constraints are met, isolating the low score to intrinsic bandwidth limitations and interference pattern desynchronization rather than constraint violation.
continue_rationale: Only two rounds have executed, and the score decline from 0.8497 to 0.6163 represents a single negative improvement step, not the two-consecutive-round stagnation required by the stop condition. The positive tightest_margin (0.9090) and non-zero valid_candidates (9) prove the design space remains physically accessible. The large drop indicates the optimizer converged to a local minimum under the current initialization, necessitating a targeted reset rather than termination.
insight_for_next: Discard the wavelength-adaptive initialization; instead, force all odd/even layer pairs to initialize at strict quarter-wave thicknesses centered exactly at 550 nm (d_odd = 550/(4*n_odd), d_even = 550/(4*n_even)). Run a fresh multi-start optimization with expanded layer-search bounds and increased max_evaluations to force the solver out of the current spectral basin before re-measuring the score trajectory.
insight_grounding: The optimizer drifted minimally between evaluations without recovering performance (e.g., candidate_thicknesses_nm[3][0] shifted from 67.0 nm to 64.0864 nm, and candidate_thicknesses_nm[3][1] shifted from 266.0 nm to 280.5257 nm), locking the structure into a suboptimal interference regime while scores fell from score_history[0]=0.8497367 to score_history[1]=0.6163350. Meanwhile, tightest_margin=0.9090179 confirms constraint slack existed throughout, proving the search trapped locally rather than hitting boundary limits.
